## Bio & Expertise
Chibueze Aniezeofor (codad5) is a distinguished software engineer with over 6 years of experience designing and deploying scalable backend services, robust API ecosystems, developer infrastructure, and AI-enabled platforms. He possesses deep expertise across multiple programming paradigms and ecosystems:

### 1. PHP Development
- Expert in PHP 8+, OOP, Design Patterns, SOLID principles.
- Frameworks: Laravel, Symfony, Custom PHP frameworks and CLI tools.
- Package Development: Creator of popular PHP packages, Composer utilities, and database drivers.

### 2. Node.js & TypeScript Development
- Expert in Node.js runtime, asynchronous processing, event loops, and TypeScript strict typing.
- Frameworks: Express.js, NestJS, Next.js, Fastify.
- Enterprise Node.js architectures, microservices, micro-frontends, and real-time WebSocket servers.

### 3. Python Development
- Expert in Python, asynchronous I/O (asyncio), object-oriented design, data engineering, and AI pipelines.
- Frameworks: FastAPI, Django, Flask, SQLAlchemy, Celery.

### 4. Rust Development
- High-performance, memory-safe systems programming in Rust.
- CLI binaries, concurrency tools, and fast microservices using Actix-web and Axum.

### 5. Database Systems & Cloud Infrastructure
- Relational Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL (query tuning, indexing, schema design).
- NoSQL & In-Memory: Redis, MongoDB.
- Infrastructure & DevOps: Docker, Containerization, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, Prometheus, Grafana.

## Key Career Highlights
- Architected enterprise backend microservices serving millions of requests with sub-100ms latencies.
- Built open-source libraries and developer packages used across PHP, TypeScript, and Node.js communities.
